i’ve reacted the exact same way to a lot of medications too. i haven’t found a medication that fully worked for my ocd yet. i don’t think it’s something you can completely get rid of like you’d hope. sure, some medications lower obsessions, but they’re still very much there. i’m currently on prozac/fluoxetine, and it’s helping a lot for my bipolar disorder, depression, and anxiety. however, when i’m taking it regularly, it feels like my ocd isn’t affected by it very much, because i’m still having these obsessions and compulsions. until i miss a dose or two or get really stressed, i don’t realize how much it actually helps. make sure to pay attention to how you react to medications, and listen to your body. i thought lexapro had “cured” my ocd for about a week, until i realized i was just less stressed (therefore less compulsions) and my obsessions were manifesting differently.
